top_signals.title: Hitachi, Platinum Are Said Among Bidders for Swarco Unit
top_signals.summary: An arm of Hitachi Ltd. is among suitors bidding for part of Swarco, the traffic solutions provider owned by members of Austria’s Swarovski family, people familiar with the matter said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trainline hits out at tube strikes and fare freeze as growth stalls
top_signals.summary: Trainline has hit out at tube strikes and the government’s freeze on rail fares, as the train ticketing platform saw sales growth grind to a halt.
